To evaluate the given expression, we use PEMDAS.

First, we compute the expression inside the parentheses:

$$
\begin{aligned}10÷{5}^{0}+(9-5)=10÷{5}^{0}+4\end{aligned}
$$

Next, notice that $5^0=1.$ So, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}10÷{5}^{0}+4 & = \\ 10÷1+4 & = \\ 10+4 & = \\ 14\end{aligned}
$$
